facts.label: Dicas de sono
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para conselhos: You should go to bed earlier. Use always, usually, often, sometimes e never antes do verbo.

facts.label: Conselho
facts.sub: Para dar conselho, use should + verbo base: You should go to bed earlier. You should put it away. Depois de should não use to. A forma é a mesma para todos.

facts.label: Frequência
facts.sub: Use always, usually, often, sometimes e never antes do verbo: I never sleep well. I always read a book. Com be, a palavra vem depois: She is always tired.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Never means not at any time.
After should, we use to + verb.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Never means not at any time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After should, we use to + verb. → Falso (We use the base verb.)
“I always read” means every time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is Wednesday morning in a shared flat in Halifax. Gray light comes through the curtains. Sara walks into the kitchen with tired eyes. Her roommate Hal makes toast. He looks at her and smiles. He asks about her night.
“You look tired, Sara. Do you sleep well?” says Hal. “No, I never sleep well. I often wake up at night.” says Sara. “What time do you usually go to bed?” says Hal.
